content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: ICMR NITHR Young Professional-I (Admin) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NITHR Young Professional-I (Admin) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I (Admin) post is scheduled for 06 October 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I (Admin) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognized University/College and possess at least one year of post-qualification experience in a relevant field.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional-I (Admin) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I (Admin) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I (Admin) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-I (Admin) position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICMR National Institute for Tribal Health Research, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, 482003.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.
